root_cause_label: Agent applied all Makefile changes and built/ran the project in /app/src instead of /app, never recognizing that the task required /app/Makefile and artifacts at the /app level.
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly modernized the Fortran build configuration but applied all edits and artifact generation in /app/src rather than /app, so the benchmark's test harness found no /app/Makefile or /app/output.txt and scored the task as failed.
t_err_evidence: Step 6: `cd /app/src && sed -i 's/FC = ifort_proprietary_compiler/FC = gfortran/' Makefile && sed -i 's/-fast/-O3 -fopenmp/' Makefile` — the agent modifies /app/src/Makefile instead of creating or modifying /app/Makefile, committing to a workflow based in the wrong directory.
t_commit_evidence: Step 6 is also the commit point: after editing /app/src/Makefile with sed, every subsequent action (build, run, verify, completion) doubles down on /app/src; the agent never reconsiders this choice.
trigger_explanation: The agent observed that /app/src contained the Makefile and sources (steps 2-3) and silently assumed that working in /app/src was correct. It never read any task specification that would have clarified the expected /app-level artifact locations, and it never questioned why /app itself had no Makefile.
forewarning_evidence: Step 1: `ls -la /app/` returned only a `src` directory — no Makefile in /app. This was a clear signal that the task might require creating or populating /app/Makefile, but the agent ignored it and proceeded directly into /app/src.
